name: Shamoon
desc: Malware family targeting energy, government, and telecom in the middle east and europe.

acts.d: Shamoon is placed on the target system through unknown means
Shamoon dropper contains 3 components masked as encrypted files embedded in the PE sections
Shamoon dropper decrypts several strings in memory
Shamoon gathers information on the System and determines whether to drop the 32-bit or 64-bit version
Shamoon drops a file key8854321.pub into the folder c:\Windows\Temp\key8854321.pub
Shamoon dropper decrypts 2 files for later use
Shamoon enables the service RemoteRegistry to remotely modify the registry
Shamoon enables the registry key LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy, which disables remote user account control
Malware checks if specific shares exist to copy and spread itself
Shamoon queries LocalService to retrieve specific information related to the LocalService account
Shamoon dropper decrypts the embedded resources into the C:\Windows\System32 folder
The file times are set to August 2012 as an anti-forensics trick
Shamoon elevates privileges by impersonating the user's token
Shamoon creates a new service MaintenaceSrv with the Autostart option and runs the service with its own process
Wiper is dropped into the System32 folder
Worm is dropped into the System32 folder
Shamoon wiper component contains the wiper driver embedded in its resources
Worm scans the local network for potential control servers to connect to
Shamoon wiper decrypts the wiper driver
Worm can spread the Shamoon dropper to remote systems
The wiper driver creates a service to run the driver
The wiper driver overwrites every file in C:\Windows\System32 and all files on the system
Disk wiper forces a reboot
